concerns.text: FR-002 (residue aggregation) has no task explicitly covering it. T006 implements residue aggregation but is only tagged [FR-001]; a dedicated task or tag for FR-002 is missing.

FR-004 (visualization report containing test statistics, p‑values, and degrees of freedom) is not linked to any task. T010 creates plots but is only tagged [FR-005]; a task or tag for FR-004 is required.

SC-001 (validation of computed φ values against known mathematical values) lacks a dedicated task. While T006’s verification mentions φ values, no task is explicitly assigned to this success criterion.
SC-002 (validation of statistical inference using synthetic uniform/biased datasets) is not covered by any task. T008’s unit‑test description mentions synthetic data but no task is tagged for SC-002.

The implementation plan references a Phase 8 timing verification (wall‑clock ≤ 1 hour) but no tasks are defined for this phase. A task to run the full pipeline and assert the timing constraint is missing.
No task explicitly validates that the JSON artefacts conform to the `dataset.schema.yaml` and `statistical_result.schema.yaml` contracts. Adding a contract‑validation task would ensure compliance.
